cards.card_text: Back to the second ram, the ram for ordination: Moses is to put its fat and right thigh, plus one loaf, one cake and one wafer from the basket, in the hands of Aaron and his sons.
cards.verse_text: Take the fat from the ram, the fat tail, the fat covering the entrails, the lobe of the liver, both kidneys with the fat on them, and the right thigh (since this is a ram for ordination), along with one loaf of bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that is before the LORD.
cards.snippet: …on them, and the right thigh (since this is a ram for ordination), along with one loaf of bread, one cake of bread made with…

cards.card_text: He's to wave the breast of the ordination ram too, and that breast will be his portion.
cards.verse_text: Take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s ordination and wave it before the LORD as a wave offering, and it will be your portion.
cards.snippet: Take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s ordination and wave it before the LORD as a wave offering, and it…

cards.card_text: Moses is to boil the ordination ram's meat in a holy place, and Aaron and his sons are to eat it at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting with the bread from the basket.
cards.verse_text: You are to take the ram of ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place.
cards.snippet: You are to take the ram of ordination and boil its flesh in a holy place.

cards.card_text: God says no outsider may eat the ordination meat and bread.
cards.verse_text: They must eat those things by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration.
cards.snippet: They must eat those things by which atonement was made for their ordination and consecration.

cards.card_text: And that's the law of the burnt, grain, sin, guilt, ordination and peace offerings.
cards.verse_text: This is the law of the burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the ordination offering, and the peace offering,
cards.snippet: …burnt offering, the grain offering, the sin offering, the guilt offering, the ordination offering, and the peace offering,

cards.card_text: After that comes the other ram, the ram of ordination, and Aaron and his sons lay their hands on its head.
cards.verse_text: After that, Moses presented the other ram, the ram of ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
cards.snippet: After that, Moses presented the other ram, the ram of ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.

cards.card_text: Then Moses takes the breast, his own portion of the ram of ordination, and waves it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded him.
cards.verse_text: He also took the breast—Moses’ portion of the ram of ordination—and waved it before the LORD as a wave offering, as the LORD had commanded him.
cards.snippet: He also took the breast—Moses’ portion of the ram of ordination—and waved it before the LORD as a wave offering, as the LORD…

cards.card_text: Then Moses tells Aaron and his sons to boil the meat at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and eat it right there with the bread from the basket of ordination offerings.
cards.verse_text: And Moses said to Aaron and his sons, “Boil the meat at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and eat it there with the bread that is in the basket of ordination offerings, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons are to eat it.’
cards.snippet: …eat it there with the bread that is in the basket of ordination offerings, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons are to eat…

cards.card_text: Then Moses gives them a stay-put order: they must not go outside the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of their ordination are complete.
cards.verse_text: You must not go outside the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your ordination are complete; for it will take seven days to ordain you.
cards.snippet: …the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your ordination are complete; for it will take seven days to ordain you.
